title: Apex Auto Credit Review
content: Apex Auto has diversified OEM relationships but remains exposed to imported electronics and copper prices. Covenant headroom is narrowing. The client is suitable for FX risk management and supply-chain payment solutions.

title: Nova Textiles Working Capital Memo
content: Nova Textiles has high export concentration and elongated receivables. Debt service capacity has weakened. Any new exposure should require a collections tracker, promoter support, and close covenant monitoring.

title: Helio Foods Growth Plan
content: Helio Foods is growing distribution in South India and increasing retail channel depth. The client has low leverage, growing balances, and opportunity for channel finance, merchant acquiring, and treasury surplus deposits.
